Incoterms 2020

Nomina dell’Ormeggio

The formal assignment or request for a specific berth at a port, usually made by the vessel’s agent or shipping line, required for scheduling arrival, mooring, and cargo operations.

Quick answer: The formal assignment or request for a specific berth at a port, usually made by the vessel’s agent or shipping line, required for scheduling arrival, mooring, and cargo operations.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Nomina dell’Ormeggio matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Nomina dell’Ormeggio?

In this glossary, Nomina dell’Ormeggio refers to: The formal assignment or request for a specific berth at a port, usually made by the vessel’s agent or shipping line, required for scheduling arrival, mooring, and cargo operations.

How is Nomina dell’Ormeggio used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Il vettore ha presentato una richiesta di nomina dell’ormeggio all’autorità portuale per ottenere una posizione adatta allo scarico della nave."

Why does Nomina dell’Ormeggio matter in logistics?

Nomina dell’Ormeggio matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Nomina dell’Ormeggio?

Nomina dell’Ormeggio is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The formal assignment or request for a specific berth at a port, usually made by the vessel’s agent or shipping line, required for scheduling arrival, mooring, and cargo operations.

Operational example

The carrier submitted a berth nomination request to the port authority to secure a suitable location for unloading the vessel’s cargo.

Localized term

Nomina dell’Ormeggio

Localized example

Il vettore ha presentato una richiesta di nomina dell’ormeggio all’autorità portuale per ottenere una posizione adatta allo scarico della nave.
